g.aria-label: Time-Invariant SSM Dual Mode: O(T log T) FFT Convolution vs. O(1) Step
Why Time-Invariant SSMs Enjoy Two Equivalent Execution Modes
• Training (full sequence known): evaluate y = K * x + D x across all T tokens via FFT
• Autoregressive Decoding: switch to h_t = ā ⊙ h_{t-1} + b̄ x_t in O(N) state and O(1) time/tok
